classification: Interrupted/failed startup diagnostic; excluded as a canonical statistical reference

definitions.pressure_input: primitive binary 'eint' is p_parallel, not thermal energy
definitions.PDF: sum(cell volume in bin)/(domain volume * bin width); shared edges include every retained cell
definitions.time_average: trapezoidal integration of snapshot diagnostics over actual retained times, divided by covered duration
definitions.blocks: contiguous physical-time blocks; linearly interpolated diagnostic endpoints; sample SD/range of block means, not an iid confidence interval
definitions.derivatives: second-order centered periodic differences on the uniform full 3D mesh
definitions.S_parallel: b_i b_j partial_j u_i, b=B/|B| (local instantaneous direction)
definitions.projected_gradients: G_ij=partial_j u_i, P_ij=delta_ij-b_i*b_j; parallel/perpendicular components are b.G.b, P.G.b, b.G.P, P.G.P, projected after differentiating u; no derivatives of b enter these four components
definitions.parallel_velocity: u_parallel=u dot b; this includes the retained bulk velocity
definitions.parallel_velocity_derivative: b dot grad(u dot b) = S_parallel + u dot [(b dot grad)b] in the continuum; discretization need not obey the product rule exactly
definitions.induction: S_parallel-div(u) reconstructs ideal material D ln|B|/Dt; not a measured time derivative or resistive/numerical induction budget
definitions.pressure_balance: corr(delta p_perp, delta(B^2/2)); R=mean[(delta p_perp+delta(B^2/2))^2]/(var(p_perp)+var(B^2/2)); exact compensation gives corr=-1,R=0
definitions.pressure_balance_by_scale: Paa/Pbb are shell sums of squared FFT/N of mean-subtracted p_perp and B^2/2, divided by dk; Pab is the signed real cross spectrum. Average these powers in physical time before C=Pab/sqrt(Paa*Pbb), R=(Paa+Pbb+2*Pab)/(Paa+Pbb), separately for the full interval and each block. C is signed correlation, not squared coherence; zero denominators are unavailable. Perpendicular shells sum all k_parallel; full_k_resolved uses the same conservative full-wavevector mask for all three powers
definitions.FFT: F=fftn(field)/N; shell power=sum_shell |F|^2 / dk; integral over all shells (including k_perp=0) equals the stated real-space mean square
definitions.shells: k_perp=sqrt(kx^2+ky^2) relative to the initial z guide field; physical radians/length; bins [n*dk,(n+1)*dk), dk=min(2*pi/Lx,2*pi/Ly)
definitions.kinetic_spectrum: FFT of sqrt(rho/2)*(u-u_bulk), u_bulk=<rho*u>/<rho>; no further mean removal; integral=mean[rho*|u-u_bulk|^2/2]
definitions.pressure_spectra: FFT of each scalar minus its volume mean; unnormalized physical pressure units; integral=variance
definitions.gradient_spectra: FFT of each reconstructed scalar/vector minus its component means; signed fields are squared only by the power spectrum; spectra do not determine signs
definitions.Mach: u_rms about volume-mean velocity / sqrt(gamma*<p_iso>/<rho>), p_iso=(p_parallel+2*p_perp)/3; isotropic-pressure proxy, not a CGL characteristic-wave Mach number
definitions.Mach_isothermal: passive only: u_rms about volume-mean velocity / retained iso_sound_speed; this is the sound speed of the actual isothermal dynamics
definitions.passive_pressure: passive p_parallel and p_perp remain CGL thermal diagnostics without a momentum force; dynamic_isothermal_pressure=iso_sound_speed^2*rho is the pressure in the passive momentum equation; dynamic_pressure_* compares this pressure with B^2/2
definitions.passive_energy: cgl-J and cgl-A are material-invariant integrals, not energies; thermal-U=integral(p_perp+p_parallel/2)dV is passive thermal energy; force_work measures the kinetic-energy change of forcing kicks. KE+ME+thermal-U has no active-CGL conserved-energy closure
definitions.beta: volume mean of 2*p_iso/B^2; also report 2*<p_iso>/<B^2>, which differs in general
definitions.deltaB: sqrt(<|B-<B>|^2>)/B0; mean field removed separately at each snapshot
definitions.forcing: actual accumulated applied forcing work is user-history force_work; force_pwr is instantaneous rho*u dot f and is not its exact quadrature
definitions.force_decomposition: nonzero Fourier acceleration modes: P_compressive=sum |k dot fhat|^2/k^2; P_solenoidal=P_total-P_compressive; this is acceleration power, not injected-energy partition
definitions.nominal_force_mixture: expected_solenoidal_power_fraction and expected_solenoidal_fraction retain the nominal ratio of expected isotropic innovation powers, 2*s^2/[2*s^2+(1-s)^2]; this is not the expectation of an instantaneous fraction or a target for one finite OU realization
definitions.precision: primitive/force snapshots may be float32; strict threshold crossings are descriptive and not tight full-precision admissibility tests
definitions.X_rounding_envelope: half the larger adjacent float32 gap for each stored pressure/B component; bound |delta X| <= [2*(delta p_perp+delta p_parallel)+|X|*delta(B^2)]/[B^2-delta(B^2)], delta(B^2)=sum(2*|Bi|*delta Bi+delta Bi^2); no dynamical-error claim
definitions.limiter_history: mirror_vol/fire_vol are inclusive threshold predicates; with nu_coll=0, both soft limiters enabled and backups disabled, nu_eff/(limiter_nu_coll*volume) measures the strict soft-rate fraction at history sampling; hard_vol counts strict physical firehose violation even with backups off
definitions.LF_counters: lf_nstage counts cumulative active-cell LF-stage checks; lf_hardbd counts cumulative hard-bound crossings in those unprojected checks, with repeated cells counted repeatedly. nonfin/nonpos also inspect active cells; dfloor/pfloor accumulate EOS refresh events including refreshed halo cells. All persist restart and do not reset at history output. In audited post-WO2 simulation revisions 7a37710f6 and 71ad25ebc, lf_hwproj is a reserved, uninstrumented field: its retained value does not measure wall projections or their absence. Physical stage crossings are not automatically numerical failure

findings.reason: Passive run ended with a real pressure-floor event in pre-LF RKL stage13/15 before planned averaging; active was stopped on user request. Zero retained counters before the later failure do not validate the failed step.

Active magnetic-strength distribution is narrower and resolved S_parallel is reduced, while both retain appreciable parallel velocity. One growing finite-time realization and a failed passive evolution do not validate stationary turbulence.

findings.scope: resolved-scale directional evidence in retained intervals
findings.reason: Signed cross spectra show C<0 and R<1 beyond forcing scales; active [2,6] C=-.941/R=.059 at k_perp/(2pi)=8.5 despite weak whole-box correlation. Matching pressure powers alone is not the evidence.

Early pair is startup dominated. Later active compensated kinetic spectrum has only a short approximately level interval before roll-off; no broad inertial range, stationary sample, convergence or fitted-slope acceptance is established.

sampling.endpoint_rule: linearly interpolate diagnostic values/PDF bins/spectral bins at requested endpoints using bracketing snapshots; no field interpolation or extrapolation
sampling.instantaneous_output_caveat: post-operator snapshots may miss transient threshold excursions; inclusive history switches, strict exceedance, and near bands have different meanings

magnetic_strength_distribution_width.definition: Time-volume pooled std(|B|/B0)=sqrt(2*time_mean(magnetic_density)/B0^2-time_mean(mean(|B|/B0))^2), computed from exact field moments rather than histogram centers. Block widths use the same formula within each time block. Includes temporal drift of the mean; distinct from vector deltaB_rms/B0.

scale_bands.definition: resolved guide <=Nyquist/4 (>=8 cells per axis wavelength); scalar resolved ratios require 0<full |k|<=min(Nyquist_xyz)/4, including pure parallel modes at k_perp=0; plotted perpendicular shells sum all k_parallel, so low-k_perp alone does not guarantee resolved full wavevector; not a convergence claim

spectral_sample_rule: Sample five predeclared shell centers n_perp=k_perp/(2pi)=2.5,4.5,8.5,16.5,23.5. Compensated values are E_K*k_perp^(5/3), divided by their n_perp=2.5 value. These are shape diagnostics, not a slope fit or acceptance tolerance. Full-|k| filter means 0<|k|<=min(Nyquist_xyz)/4.

pressure_tail_audit.classification: Retrospective positive-state pressure heterogeneity audit, not a diagnosis of the later negative RKL stage
pressure_tail_audit.scope: All11 retained passive primitive snapshots, volume-weighted equal-volume cell moments/quantiles; float32 output read into float64. U=p_perp+p_parallel/2. Standard deviations are spatial, not temporal uncertainty.

limitations: Neither requested retrospective interval is the canonical [6,14] window.
Four .5-time startup blocks and four1-time active blocks are descriptive and correlated (forcing tcorr=2); sample SD is not standard error or confidence interval.
No full-precision state at the original failure was dumped; the retained float32 snapshot at2.5003 remained positive.
Passive thermal pressure is a diagnostic; actual isothermal momentum pressure is5*rho.
No spatial-convergence, active/passive ensemble, or LF-coefficient-validation claim.
Initial96PLM reference has different grid, reconstruction and averaging epoch; this comparison is not a controlled convergence test.

same_settings_diagnostic_replay.caution: Diagnostic replay evidence supplements the original sparse progress log; this small-data retrospective review does not identify the upstream origin of the cold entry state.
